basic_info.description: 358 El Camino Del Mar is a gorgeous Sea Cliff residence featuring four bedrooms, three full bathrooms, two half bathrooms, 6,725 square feet of living space and views of the Golden Gate Bridge and Pacific Ocean. The property is perfect for entertaining with grand scale living spaces and a ballroom. Additional features include a two-car garage, spacious kitchen with ample storage and center island, library, home office, five fireplaces, exceptional natural light, gym area, sauna, & kitchenette. The property's premier location offers incredible nature escapes and hiking trails including Land's End National Park, Baker Beach, and the Presidio of San Francisco.
